responses.title: Welcome / first reply
responses.text: Hi! Thank you so much for reaching out to Sparkle Home Cleaning! 😊 We'd love to help you keep your home spotless. Could you tell me a little about your home (size, number of bedrooms and bathrooms) and how often you'd like the cleaning? Then I can send you all the details and a quote!

responses.title: Ask for house details
responses.text: To give you an accurate quote, could you share: 1) the approximate size of your home (square feet), 2) number of bedrooms and bathrooms, 3) if you have pets, and 4) how often you'd like the service (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly)? Thank you!

responses.title: What's included - regular cleaning
responses.text: Our regular cleaning is very detailed and includes: bed linen change, interior microwave cleaning, kitchen counters fully cleared and cleaned underneath, glass/sliding kitchen doors cleaned inside and out, dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bathrooms, and kitchen. We take care of every detail so your home feels fresh in every corner!

responses.title: Windows not included in regular
responses.text: Just so you know, window cleaning is not included in the regular cleaning — but it can be added as an extra service or done as part of a deep clean. I'll send you a catalog with everything that's included in both the regular and deep cleaning!

responses.title: What's included - deep cleaning
responses.text: Our deep cleaning covers everything in the regular cleaning plus: baseboards, interior windows, inside the oven and refrigerator, cabinet fronts, door frames, light switches, vents, and hard-to-reach areas. It's perfect for a first visit or a seasonal refresh!

responses.title: Regular vs deep - difference
responses.text: Great question! The regular cleaning keeps your home fresh week to week (surfaces, floors, bathrooms, kitchen, linen change). The deep cleaning goes further — baseboards, inside appliances, interior windows, vents, and detailed corners. Most clients start with a deep clean, then keep a regular schedule.

responses.title: Monthly price - large home
responses.text: For a home around 3,000 sq ft, our monthly regular cleaning is $250 per visit. That includes our full detailed service — bed linen change, microwave interior, counters cleared and cleaned, and glass kitchen doors inside and out. Would you like to schedule a first visit?

responses.title: Carpet cleaning add-on
responses.text: Yes, we do offer carpet cleaning! It's not included in the standard price — it's charged separately per room/area, around $60–$80 each, depending on the size and the level of dirt. Would you like me to add it to your service?

responses.title: Deep clean price varies
responses.text: The deep cleaning price depends on the size and current condition of the home. After you share the details (size, bedrooms, bathrooms), I'll send you an exact quote — no surprises, the price we agree on is the price you pay!

responses.title: Availability / book a visit
responses.text: We'd love to get you on the schedule! What days and times usually work best for you? We'll do our best to find a spot that fits your routine — mornings and afternoons are available.

responses.title: Appointment confirmation
responses.text: Perfect, you're all set! ✨ Your cleaning is confirmed for [DAY, DATE] at [TIME]. We bring all our own supplies and equipment. If anything changes, just send us a message. See you soon!

responses.title: Reschedule request
responses.text: No problem at all — life happens! 😊 What new day and time would work better for you? I'll check our schedule and confirm right away.

responses.title: We bring our own supplies
responses.text: You don't need to provide anything — we bring all our own professional supplies and equipment! If you prefer specific products (or eco-friendly/pet-safe options), just let us know and we're happy to use them.

responses.title: Pets are welcome
responses.text: We love pets! 🐾 It helps to know in advance how many pets you have and if there's anything we should keep in mind (like keeping a door closed). We use pet-safe products upon request.

responses.title: Move-in / move-out cleaning
responses.text: Yes, we do move-in/move-out cleanings! It's a complete top-to-bottom service for an empty home: inside cabinets, appliances, closets, baseboards, and more — perfect for getting a deposit back or starting fresh. Share the home size and I'll send a quote!

responses.title: After the first cleaning
responses.text: Hi! We hope you loved your first cleaning with us! 💛 Was everything to your satisfaction? Your feedback helps us take even better care of your home. If you'd like, I can already reserve your spot for the next visit.

responses.title: Review request
responses.text: So happy you're pleased with our service! If you have a minute, a quick Google review would mean the world to our small business. ⭐ Thank you so much for your trust — see you at the next cleaning!

responses.title: Polite close - not interested
responses.text: Thank you so much for considering Sparkle Home Cleaning! If anything changes or you'd like a quote in the future, we're always here. Wishing you a wonderful week! 😊

responses.title: Payment methods
responses.text: We accept Zelle, Venmo, cash, or check — whatever is easiest for you! Payment is due on the day of the cleaning. A receipt is available upon request.

responses.title: Satisfaction guarantee
responses.text: Your satisfaction is our priority! If anything was missed or isn't perfect, let us know within 24 hours and we'll come back and make it right — free of charge, no questions asked.
